categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, maintenance, and services of large and medium-sized military aircraft, civil aviation components, and aviation services. Key products include military transport aircraft, bombers, special aircraft, and major components for domestic and international civil aircraft such as C909, C919, AG600, and parts for Airbus A320/A321 and Boeing 737 series. It also provides aviation engineering support, technical documentation, user training, material support, and aircraft maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital design and manufacturing technologies, including digitalized aircraft development systems and integrated manufacturing of fuselage and wing components. It emphasizes innovation in aerospace manufacturing, lean management, and intelligent factory operations. The company holds numerous national patents and focuses on breakthroughs in unmanned aerial vehicle technologies and low-cost manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international aircraft manufacturers such as Airbus, Boeing, COMAC, and AVIC General Aircraft. The company serves military and civil aviation sectors, providing components and services for large and medium-sized aircraft. It also supports emergency rescue equipment and low-altitude economy applications, with a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant production bases in Shaanxi Province (Xi'an and Hanzhong) and Tianjin. It has established international cooperation and supply relationships with global aerospace companies, serving markets in Europe, the United States, and other regions. Domestic sales account for the majority of revenue, with a growing share from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, assembly, and maintenance of aircraft and key components. It acts as a major integrator and supplier of critical aircraft structures and parts, supporting both original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening military-civil integration, advancing innovation-driven development, and enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company focuses on key technology breakthroughs in large aircraft, unmanned systems, and aviation services. It pursues high-quality, efficient, low-cost, and sustainable growth, with initiatives in digital transformation, supply chain optimization, and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aircraft and aviation components, supplemented by service contracts including maintenance, repair, overhaul, and technical support. The company also earns income from international subcontracting projects and government subsidies related to aviation technology and infrastructure development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in China's aerospace industry, holding a significant position in military and civil aviation sectors. It competes with other major Chinese aerospace firms and international suppliers by leveraging its integrated manufacturing capabilities and strategic partnerships with global aircraft manufacturers. It is recognized for high-quality production and timely delivery in both domestic and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 43.2 billion, representing a 7.23% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.02 billion, up 18.87%. Total assets stood at around RMB 73.8 billion with a net asset value of RMB 21 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding civil aviation orders and enhanced operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive capabilities in integrated aircraft component manufacturing, advanced digital design, and high-quality aviation services. It differentiates itself through strong innovation, reliable delivery performance, and deep integration in both domestic and international aerospace supply chains. Its strategic partnerships with global aerospace leaders and focus on sustainable, cost-effective production provide competitive advantages.
